Khushi barfili raat mein garam aag ke paas rehna hai.
Khushi intensity ki nahi balki balance, order, rhythm aur meaning ki baat hai.
Khushi hamari halat mein nahi, hamare khud ke andar hai.
Azadi woh hawa hai jo hum lete hain.
Khushi chodi hai.
Azaadi hawa hai.
Azadi insaaf ka saar hai.
Sabse khush woh hai jo apne baare mein sabse kam sochta hai.
Happiness ek endless winding road hai.
Freedom subah ke forest ki shanti hai.
Azaad log yeh yaad rakhein: hum azaadi paa sakte hain, par ek baar khone ke baad wapas nahi milti.
Khushi sarvashaktimaan taakat hai.
Joy dil ki sadgi hai.
Azaad jiyo ya mar jao.
Sachi azadi bina anushasan ke bani dimaag ke namumkin hai.
Happiness backpack zip ki aawaz hai.
Freedom pahad ke pattharo par nange paon chalti hai.
Khushi rooh hai.
Khushi ek tohfa hai.
Khushi aantarik azadi hai.
Khushi hamare andar ki shuddh aag hai.
Khushi achhai dekhna hai.
Azaadi se bolna loktantra ka khoon hai.
Liberty samooh ke liye wohi hai jo sehat vyakti ke shareer ke liye hai.
Azadi jeevan hai.
Apne footprints ko apni story batane do.
